title.narrative: Advancing Decent Work in Bangladesh

description.narrative: Contract related to: Advancing Decent Work in Bangladesh - The Action will help the Government of Bangladesh to fulfil targets under the EU National Action Plan (NAP) on the Labour Sector in Bangladesh (2021-2026) and the ILO- GoB Roadmap. It aims to support the GoB and national constituents in implementation of legal and administrative reforms to uphold labour rights and workplace safety under NAP. It will consist of 3 specific objectives: 1) support labour law implementation and administration; 2) promote sustainable, responsible and competitive enterprises and 3) support child labour elimination. The Action aligns with the GoB¿s priorities and supports the country¿s vision to eradicate poverty and prepare for the Least Developed Country (LDC) graduation in 2026.

This indicator also measure the number of system applied to make these institutions more effective and transparent. The institutional capacity of the four existing labour market administration institutions (MoLE, DIFE, DoL, Labour Judiciary) will also be assessed considering four OECD Principles for the good governance : IntegrityTransparencyAccountabilityPublic representation in decision making

This indicator reflects the extent to which delays in the registration of trade unions have been minimized, highlighting improvements in administrative processes and responsiveness to trade union applications.
